task.question: How many all-cause deaths per year in the contiguous United States were attributed to wildfire smoke PM2.5 in February 2026?
task.evidence: 4 February: a study published in Science Advances concluded that wildfire smoke fine particulate matter (PM2.5) was responsible for ~24,100 all-cause deaths per year in the contiguous United States.
